description: Repairs r-err-1b/lock-readonly-db-insert: the INSERT ran through Database.Execute without dbFailOnError (128) and the table was never read back, so the record cannot say whether ACE refused the row, skipped it silently or accepted it; the read-only Database's insert also had no read-back. A second Database dro is opened read-only on the same file. Errors read; every row of Q read through a snapshot on db and on dro (the baseline); dro.Execute of "INSERT INTO Q (ID, V) VALUES (50, 'z')" with dbFailOnError (128); Errors read; RecordsAffected of dro read; every row of Q read through a new snapshot on db and on dro. Asks whether a read-only Database refuses the insert, the Number and message, and what Q holds afterwards. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
